diagnosis: The custom Wagtail PagesAPIViewSet filters DepartmentWikiPage by department_id from query parameters. It does not verify that request.user belongs to that department or check Wagtail view restrictions, allowing any user to read departmental intranet pages.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v2/pages/wiki/?department_id=4 HTTP/1.1
Host: intranet.company.com
Cookie: sessionid=contractor_session
